title: This Open-Source Repo is a Free Alternative to Claude Design #opendesign #claudedesign  #anthropic
description:
Someone just cloned Anthropic's Claude Design, and this open source alternative is completely free.
 
• It blew up on GitHub this week and got over eighteen thousand stars in just five days.
• It does everything Claude Design does and you get a full interactive canvas.
• You can keep prompting and refining until the design looks exactly how you want it.
• Claude Design locks you into one model but Open Design lets you pick from different code agents like Gemini and Codex.
• You can go to their website and click download desktop to try it for yourself.
 
Here are the links to download it:
Website: https://open-design.ai/
GitHub: https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design
 
I share more updates like these, so follow me to stay ahead.
